entry_conditions: Any action-supervised red phase is allowed: clear/open approach, closed-finger red lift/carry, lowering at buffer, or release/retreat. Late entry is allowed when red is stable and continuation into blue overlap is intended.
exit_conditions: Core exit is visibly stable buffered red with open/clear gripper. Segment exit can be blue closed on and beginning to lift while red stays stable. The predicted phase alone is never proof.
overlap_role: The complete 210-230 action overlap per occurrence is retained. Diffusion supervises every overlap action and auxiliary phase supervision separates release/retreat from blue approach, closure and lift.
successor_readiness: Use observed red stability, open/clear gripper and blue intent, not the auxiliary class alone. Preserve both causal frames; late switching through blue initial lift remains action-supervised.
failure_signatures: Auxiliary phase conflicts with visible object motion; red remains elevated or follows after opening; closed fingers lack object co-motion; or decoded IK has material residual or limit contact.
continuation_guidance: Reinvoke from a supervised intermediate state to refresh the TCP residual anchor. If geometry does not match a demonstrated phase or a grasp/drop failed, stop and request high-level reassessment rather than trusting the phase class.
limitations: Four phase classes are hand-derived causal supervision, not contact labels. No demonstration establishes recovery from miss, collision, drop or wrong-object contact, and TCP residual labels are not target-displacement invariant.
